telemetry_behaviour: Lite getIin() returns TPS546 output current. It is not a separately measured input current.
Lite getPin() uses regulator output voltage times output current plus a fixed5W offset.
Lite temperature before initialization uses EMC2101 internal temperature plus5C; after initialization it uses the external sensor.
Pro temperature adds10C to its inherited board temperature reading. The source says this approximates real chip temperature.

nvs_template_notes: The captured HEAD README names release/ paths that return 404. Both actual templates are present under config/ at the exact pinned HEAD commit.

Both templates set 600 MHz and 1150 mV. The Lite board constructor defaults to 515 MHz. The simulator must load the actual NVS and configuration precedence; a constructor default alone is insufficient.
